newsitem.title: USA: Columbia/HCA scrutinized in Miami - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Columbia/HCA scrutinized in Miami - WSJ.

text.p: Columbia/HCA Healthcare Corp's physician-referral methods in Miami are being examined by federal investigators, the Wall Street Journal said in Monday's electronic edition.

The U.S. Justice Department and the Department of Health and Human Services are looking into referrals of Medicare patients to Columbia/HCA facilities in Miami, the newspaper said, citing government officials.

A federal official was quoted in the report as saying the Miami probe centered around referrals to home health-care, like an investigation into the company's El Paso, Texas operations. The company was not immediately available to comment on the article.

The Journal quoted a Columbia/HCA spokeswoman in Nashville as saying she was unaware of any federal inquiry in Miami and it quoted a company's spokesman for Columbia's South Florida operations as also saying he had no knowledge of a government investigation of the firm's facilities in the region.
Officials at Health and Human Services, the Federal Bureau of Investigations and the U.S. Attorney's office in Miami and Tampa was also quoted as declining to comment, it said.
